note: Replaces the earlier invented 'content-modes.json' (lesson-series vs scripture-navigation). Real system is a MULTI-select cart of independent modules that all live under one app/spec (see the reference builder interview spec, 'module_cart'). No modules preselected.

modules.label: Scripture Messaging
modules.sub: Personal messages anchored in a fitting Bible verse - encouragement, follow-up, invitations, prayer, celebrations.
modules.note: Expands at build time into the selected message-theme mode ids; never stored as 'messaging' in the spec.

modules.label: Daily Bible Verse
modules.sub: One Bible verse each day for the whole team, with optional audio and a reflection question, made to be shared into group chats.

modules.label: Lesson Plan
modules.sub: Curated multi-week lesson plans around themes like discipleship, trauma healing, and Bible study, matched to your audience and their journey of faith.

modules.label: Bible Reader
modules.sub: A guided reader for one or two Bible books of your choice, with audio, study notes, highlights, and personal notes.

modules.label: Reading Plan
modules.sub: A day-by-day journey through a book of the Bible - whole chapters at a steady pace, with each reader moving at their own speed.

gatingRules.language_no_plans: drop 'lesson_plan' when the chosen language has no published plans in the library
